Players Committee card image of [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate 1 Force; 4-6, you may draw top card of Reserve Deck; 0 or 7, you may retrieve 1 Force.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/5d6ra7.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 ab74419] (31 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
